title: Senior Analyst - HR Operations
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

About JLL
  
**For over 200 years, JLL (NYSE:** JLL), a leading global commercial real estate and investment management company, has helped clients buy, build, occupy, manage and invest in a variety of commercial, industrial, hotel, residential and retail properties. A Fortune 500® company with annual revenue of $23\.4 billion and operations in over 80 countries around the world, our more than 112,000 employees bring the power of a global platform combined with local expertise. Driven by our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world, we help our clients, people and communities SEE A BRIGHTER WAYSM. JLL is the brand name, and a registered trademark, of Jones Lang LaSalle Incorporated. For further information, visit jll.com
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

Resolve queries and transactions related to core HR processes.
  
Conduct comprehensive audits of federal and state labor law compliance across AMER region.
  
Knowledge of state\-specific employment regulations, wage and hour laws.
  
Analyze complex business processes to identify control gaps, assess risks, and recommend practical solutions that strengthen operational effectiveness and compliance for global employees.
  
Extract, analyze, and reconcile data from Workday including employee records, compensation structures, leave tracking, and benefit enrolments.
  
Navigate government portals to verify filing accuracy and retrieve regulatory requirements.
  
Working with and assisting global employee/HR users from APAC, EMEA \& AMR.
  
Perform detailed reviews of processes, controls, and supporting evidence to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to established standards.
  
Prepare and maintain detailed workpapers documenting procedures performed, evidence reviewed, and conclusions reached, along with control documentation.
  
Prepare reports highlighting testing results, identified gaps, and remediation recommendations.
  
Assist SME/Sr. SME with building and maintenance of a knowledgebase for business related deliverables and issues that cannot be resolved through self\-service.
  
Manage multiple assignments simultaneously, effectively prioritizing activities to meet deadlines and deliver high\-quality outcomes during peak periods.
  
Own end\-to\-end resolution of complex Tier 1/2 HR cases and partner with cross\-functional teams and business stakeholders to facilitate discussions, resolve control\-related issues, and drive continuous process improvement.
  
Lead transition activities for AMER\-related HRSS work, including building and maintaining process documentation, SOPs, and knowledgebase content for the expanded scope.
  
Independently manage and prioritize expanded case volumes across APAC, EMEA, and AMR, ensuring service levels are maintained through the transition.
  
Lead quality checks and audits on AMER\-related transactions to ensure compliance with agreed KPIs, KRAs, and SLAs.
  
Act as the primary escalation point for complex AMER queries, resolving independently before involving the Manager/SME.
  
Build and maintain strong working relationships across the organization to support collaboration, knowledge sharing, and successful execution of governance and compliance initiatives.
  
Act as the regional subject matter expert for HR systems, data architecture, and strategy, guiding stakeholders on complex system and data matters.
  
Contribute to a culture of accountability, risk awareness, and operational excellence through proactive engagement, effective communication, and sound decision\-making.
  
Partner with global shared service leads to ensure data governance is upheld across the region
  
Drive self\-service adoption through AI, chatbots, and other automation initiatives.
  
Lead the review, testing, and implementation of HR technology upgrades and new functionality.
  
Escalate recurring data quality problems and possible solutions to HRIS/JLLT.
  
  

Key Skills
  
  

Experience navigating federal labor department websites and portals.
  
Strong understanding of Data Audits and Auditing Standards.
  
Demonstrating good understanding of core HR management practices, processes, procedures, and policies.
  
Previous experience in Workday HR environment preferred or similar HR ERP desirable.
  
Knowledge of Case Management tool ServiceNow/Workday Help is an added advantage.
  
Proficiency in audit management and data analytics.
  
Proficient/Advanced Knowledge on MS Office Suite skills like Word, Excel, Outlook. Preparing excel/analytical dashboards is an added advantage.
  
Bachelor’s/master’s degree in human resources or Personnel Management
  
3\-4 years of experience in HR or client services role is desirable.
  
Comfortable to work in Global shift timing.
  
  

Sound like you? In this role, your key responsibilities will include:
  
  

Highly Organised and Self\-motivated
  
Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with constant deadlines
  
Good Customer service skills using efficient processes
  
Proactive in achieving results and seeking improvements
  
Strong teamwork interaction and orientation
  
Attention to detail and ability to work towards tight deadlines
  
Ability to adapt and drive change to derive efficiencies/productivity
  
Result oriented and Proactive in achieving results
  
  

**What we can do for you:**  

At JLL, We make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  

Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: HR Executive
description:
**Job Summary**

ibaby is seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented HR Recruiter cum Executive to manage end\-to\-end recruitment while supporting core HR operations. This dual\-responsibility role is well suited to a candidate who is equally comfortable driving talent acquisition and handling day\-to\-day HR administration.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Recruitment**

* Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed), social media, and employee referrals
* Screen resumes and conduct preliminary telephonic and video interviews
* Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers
* Manage the offer roll\-out process and negotiate compensation within approved bands
* Maintain and regularly update the recruitment tracker / ATS
* Build and sustain a talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs
* Coordinate campus placements and walk\-in drives, as required

**HR Operations**

* Manage onboarding and induction for new joiners
* Maintain accurate employee records and HRMS data
* Support attendance, leave, and payroll coordination
* Plan and support employee engagement initiatives
* Handle documentation related to joining, confirmation, and separation formalities
* Support the implementation of HR policies and ensure compliance
* Address routine employee queries and escalate matters appropriately
* Support exit interviews and the full and final settlement process

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Good communication skills are mandatory, along with strong interpersonal skills
* Working familiarity with recruitment platforms and applicant tracking systems
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace
* Working knowledge of labour laws and HR compliance requirements
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
* High level of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in a startup or fast\-paced environment
* Exposure to HRMS platforms such as Zoho People, Keka, or Darwinbox
* HR certification (SHRM, HRCI, or equivalent) is an added advantage

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation with performance\-based incentives
* Exposure to the complete HR function within a growing organization clear growth path into senior HR / Talent Acquisition roles
* A collaborative and supportive work environment

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Deputy Manager - Cyber Security
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**BU Cyber Specialist**


**Cybersecurity Risk Identification and Mitigation:**



Identify cybersecurity risks within the business unit’s operations, including systems, processes, and workflows.



Work with cross\-functional teams to implement appropriate security measures and controls to reduce risk.



Provide guidance on threat mitigation strategies and assist with implementing security measures to address identified vulnerabilities.


**Security Incident Response:**



Act as a key contributor to the business unit’s cybersecurity incident response plan.



Assist in investigating and analyzing security incidents, ensuring timely detection, containment, and resolution of security breaches.



Work closely with the incident response team to execute response strategies and remediate vulnerabilities.


**Collaboration with IT and Business Teams:**



Partner with IT teams to ensure secure implementation and maintenance of business unit systems and applications.



Collaborate with business unit leaders to integrate cybersecurity best practices into daily operations, projects, and system development.



Provide security guidance and support to business units when implementing new technologies, applications, or processes.


**Compliance and Regulatory Support:**



Ensure the business unit complies with relevant cybersecurity regulations, standards, and internal policies (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, NIST).



Assist with audits and assessments to verify compliance with industry\-specific cybersecurity requirements.



Provide recommendations for improving security posture to ensure compliance with relevant regulations.


**Security Awareness and Training:**



Assist in the development and delivery of cybersecurity awareness and training programs tailored to the business unit’s needs.



Provide guidance to business unit staff on security best practices, including data protection, password management, and secure communication.



Promote a security\-conscious culture within the business unit by conducting ongoing awareness activities and security drills.


**Security Tools and Technologies:**



Support the implementation, configuration, and management of cybersecurity tools and technologies within the business unit.



Assist with monitoring and maintaining the security of business unit systems, including vulnerability scanning, network monitoring, and endpoint protection.



Provide recommendations on security tools and technologies that align with the business unit’s needs and the organization's overall cybersecurity strategy.


**Reporting and Communication:**



Report on cybersecurity risks, incidents, and initiatives to the Business Unit Cyber Lead and other relevant stakeholders.



Maintain documentation of security activities, incidents, and ongoing efforts to improve cybersecurity posture.



Communicate security risks and recommended actions to business unit leadership in a clear and concise manner.


**Continuous Improvement and Best Practices:**



Stay up to date with the latest cybersecurity trends, threats, and technologies to ensure that the business unit remains secure against emerging risks.



Continuously evaluate and improve cybersecurity practices and procedures within the business unit to adapt to the evolving threat landscape.



Assist in the development and implementation of security best practices for the business unit.


**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**



Business Unit Heads and Department Heads



Business Unit Cyber Lead



Information Security and IT teams



Legal, HR, and Compliance teams



Risk Management Teams


**Key Stakeholders \- External**



Regulatory Authorities and Compliance Organizations



Security Vendors and Third\-Party Service Providers



External Auditors


**Educational Qualification:**



Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.



Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA) in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a relevant discipline is highly desirable.


**Certification:**



Industry certifications such as CISSP, CompTIA Security\+, or CISM are preferred.



Solid understanding of cybersecurity risks, policies, and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR).


**Work Experience (Range of years):**



3\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on risk management, security operations, or system security.

title: Head of M365 platforms
description:
**Snapshot of the Day**
-----------------------


As the Head of M365 Platforms, you start your day reviewing platform health, adoption trends, AI capability usage, and transformation milestones across the global Microsoft 365 ecosystem. You engage with business leaders to prioritize productivity initiatives, align with cybersecurity and governance stakeholders on risk and compliance requirements, and guide your international leadership team on strategic priorities.


Throughout the day, you balance long\-term platform strategy with operational excellence, drive AI\-enabled innovation across productivity services, oversee major transformation programs, manage budget and vendor performance, and ensure employees worldwide benefit from secure, reliable, and modern workplace experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\. AI\-First Strategy \& Workplace Innovation**

* Define and execute the enterprise\-wide AI\-first strategy and roadmap for M365 productivity platforms.
* Lead the evolution of M365 Platforms into AI\-enabled Productivity Platforms aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements.
* Identify, prioritize, and scale AI and automation use cases across:
	+ Content management
	+ Low\-code solutions
	+ Productivity applications
	+ Analytics and reporting
	+ Service operations
* Drive intelligent automation to improve employee productivity, simplify user journeys, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate them into measurable business outcomes.
* Ensure responsible, secure, and compliant adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities.

### **2\. Platform Portfolio Ownership**


Own strategy, governance, lifecycle management, and performance across:

* SharePoint and Enterprise Content Services
* M365 Backup and Recovery Services
* Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Governance)
* Online Applications and Browser\-Based Productivity Services
* Power BI and Enterprise Analytics Capabilities


Key expectations:

* Deliver scalable, integrated, and user\-centric services.
* Balance innovation with service stability, risk management, security, and cost optimization.
* Ensure platform alignment with enterprise technology and business strategy.

### **3\. Global Team Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and inspire a geographically distributed, multicultural team.
* Establish accountability across architecture, engineering, service management, operations, and vendor delivery functions.
* Foster a culture of innovation, inclusion, customer focus, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Build organizational capability in AI, automation, analytics, and modern workplace technologies.
* Drive succession planning, talent development, and workforce readiness.
* Empower teams through clear strategic direction and decision\-making autonomy.

### **4\. Financial \& Commercial Management**

* Own the M365 Platforms budget, including planning, forecasting, and financial governance.
* Prioritize investments across:
	+ Operations
	+ Platform modernization
	+ Transformation programs
	+ AI\-enabled innovation initiatives
* Develop and present business cases demonstrating measurable value realization.
* Drive cost transparency, optimization, and demand management.
* Manage strategic suppliers, contracts, and service delivery partners to ensure performance and commercial value.

### **5\. Stakeholder Management \& Governance**

* Build trusted partnerships across business and functional leadership teams.
* Translate business requirements into actionable platform strategy and roadmaps.
* Collaborate with:
	+ Cybersecurity
	+ Data Protection
	+ Legal
	+ Compliance
	+ Enterprise Architecture
	+ HR
	+ Communications
	+ Workers Council representatives
* Lead governance forums and decision\-making processes for strategic platform initiatives.
* Communicate strategy, investments, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to senior leadership.
* Ensure change management, communications, and user adoption are embedded in transformation programs.

### **6\. Operational Excellence \& Transformation Delivery**

* Ensure secure, resilient, and highly available platform services.
* Establish and monitor KPIs covering:
	+ Availability
	+ User experience
	+ Platform adoption
	+ Security and compliance
	+ Cost performance
	+ Vendor performance
* Lead modernization and standardization initiatives across the global productivity ecosystem.
* Utilize analytics and user insights to continuously improve service quality.
* Proactively manage operational and transformation risks.

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* Significant leadership experience within Digital Workplace, Microsoft 365, productivity platforms, automation, analytics, or related enterprise technology domains.
* Demonstrated success in developing and delivering AI\-first strategies that produce measurable business value.
* Strong expertise across:
	+ SharePoint
	+ M365 Backup
	+ Power Platform
	+ Online Applications
	+ Power BI
* Proven experience leading global teams and large\-scale cross\-functional transformation programs.
* Strong financial management experience including budgeting, forecasting, investment planning, and cost optimization.
* Experience collaborating with cybersecurity, privacy, legal, compliance, and business stakeholders.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and vendor management skills.

**Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------

### **AI\-First Innovator**


Uses AI, automation, and data\-driven insights to reimagine digital workplace experiences and productivity platforms.

### **Strategic Operator**


Balances long\-term vision with disciplined execution and operational excellence.

### **Inclusive Global Leader**


Builds trust, accountability, and high performance across diverse international teams.

### **Trusted Business Partner**


Effectively engages business leaders, governance bodies, cybersecurity teams, and employee representatives.

### **Value\-Based Decision Maker**


Aligns investment decisions and platform priorities with measurable business outcomes.

### **Change Catalyst**


Drives adoption and transformation through compelling vision, stakeholder engagement, and organizational alignment.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

* Business value and productivity gains delivered through AI\-enabled M365 capabilities.
* Platform reliability, security, compliance, and employee experience outcomes.
* Delivery of strategic roadmaps, modernization programs, and transformation milestones.
* Budget effectiveness, cost transparency, and supplier performance.
* Successful stakeholder alignment and governance execution.
* Team engagement, capability growth, succession readiness, and delivery excellence.

**Level**
---------

**Senior Executive (SE)**  

Global executive accountability for Microsoft 365 Productivity Platforms, encompassing strategy, AI\-first transformation, service ownership, financial management, stakeholder governance, and people leadership across a global organization.

title: Rewards Services Partner, Central Team
description:
### **Job Title**

Rewards Services Partner, Central Team
### **Job Description**

**Are you ready to help build something new?**

At Philips, meaningful careers are built by stepping into opportunities that challenge you, broaden your perspective, and enable you to make an impact with care.


The Central Rewards Services team was established in August 2026 to bring together shared activities across M\&A, analytics, equity, mobility, business travel, and operations. By combining our expertise, we aim to increase agility and strengthen global consistency.


As a Rewards Services Partner, you will join us at an important stage in our journey. You will help shape how the team works, contribute across disciplines, and grow your expertise beyond a single Rewards specialization.


**In this role, you have the opportunity to..**

Help build the future of Rewards Services at Philips. You will combine ownership of Global Mobility support for the APAC region with broader contributions to global Rewards processes, including annual compensation rounds, market benchmarking, analytics, and cross\-functional improvement initiatives.


This is intentionally a diverse and evolving role. The Central Rewards Services team is new, and not every responsibility or way of working has been fully defined. You will have the space to bring ideas, test better approaches, and take ownership where your experience, curiosity, and energy can create value.


You will work with specialists across the global Rewards landscape, learn from different disciplines, and help connect activities that have traditionally been managed separately. In doing so, you will strengthen both the employee experience and the consistency and effectiveness of our Rewards services.


The role is an opportunity to broaden your career as a Rewards professional while making a visible contribution to the success of a new global team.


**Your role**

* Own and coordinate Global Mobility activities for the APAC region, providing clear guidance and a consistent experience for employees and stakeholders.
* Contribute to global Rewards cycles, including annual compensation review processes, with a focus on accurate preparation, effective coordination, and high\-quality delivery.
* Support market benchmarking and Rewards analysis, translating data into clear insights that enable informed decisions.
* Work across Central Rewards Services activities, including equity, business travel, M\&A, analytics, operations, and Rewards Excellence, based on business priorities and team needs.
* Help design and embed new ways of working that reduce duplication, improve agility, and strengthen global consistency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, clarify ownership, improve service quality, and create an even better employee and stakeholder experience.
* Build strong partnerships with a multitude of stakeholders from a great variety of functions within the organisation to deliver connected solutions.
* Use data, technology, and AI responsibly to improve insights, efficiency, and service delivery.
* Share knowledge, learn from colleagues across disciplines, and contribute to building capability within the Central Rewards Services team and the wider Rewards community.
* Take ownership beyond established boundaries when new priorities emerge, balancing flexibility with sound judgment and reliable delivery.

**The impact you can make**

Your contribution will go beyond delivering individual processes. You will help turn a newly established team into a connected and trusted global partner by:


* Ensuring a consistent, employee\-focused Global Mobility experience across the APAC region.
* Helping global Rewards processes run smoothly and deliver reliable outcomes.
* Connecting expertise and activities across Central Rewards Services so that work is performed where it creates the most value.
* Bringing forward practical ideas and turning them into improvements that can be scaled globally.
* Helping build a team culture based on collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and continuous learning.

**You're the right fit if you have:**

* A Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
* Experience in Global Mobility, Compensation, Rewards, HR Operations, or a related discipline.
* Interest in broadening your expertise across multiple Rewards areas rather than remaining within one specialization.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and complexity into clear insights and practical actions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills in a global, matrixed organization.
* The ability to organize priorities, deliver reliably, and adapt when business needs change.
* A continuous\-improvement mindset and the confidence to question existing approaches constructively.
* Curiosity, creativity, and flexibility, together with a willingness to step outside your comfort zone.
* The judgment and discretion required when working with confidential employee and business information.
* AI literacy and an interest in using technology to improve how Rewards services are delivered.

**You will thrive in this role if you...**

* Are energized by the opportunity to help create, not only to maintain.
* Can bring structure to ambiguity without waiting for every detail to be defined.
* See change as an opportunity to learn, contribute, and improve.
* Enjoy moving between regional delivery, global processes, analysis, and project work.
* Build trust through collaboration, openness, and follow\-through.
* Want to broaden your Rewards expertise and help a new team become a success.

**How we work together**  

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.  



  

**About Philips**  

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose .
  

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care .

title: Staff Representative - Talent Technology
description:

**What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):**

* Hands\-on experience using AI tools in projects, internships, or work environments
* Knowledge of automation platforms such as Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Zapier, or n8n
* Understanding of AI\-enabled technologies, automation solutions, and emerging digital learning trends

 **What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):**

* Master's degree
* L\&D background

* PowerBi, SQL, Workday

title: Global Product Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


The HR Digital Product Portfolio is one of the largest and most dynamic portfolios within BCG’s Digital Products Organization, enabling technology across BCG’s HR and People functions. Within the Talent Acquisition Product Team, the Candidate Selection squad supports the products and capabilities that underpin how BCG assesses and selects candidates.

  

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will work closely with the Product Owner, business teams, technology teams, QA, and external vendors to shape effective product solutions. You will independently explore business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate complex requirements into clear, actionable solutions, with the Product Owner providing direction and final sign\-off where appropriate.

  

* Lead and facilitate requirements discussions with business and technology teams to understand problems, user needs, business value, and the wider impact of proposed changes.
* Document clear product requirements in Jira, translating business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, use cases, and solution options.
* Challenge requests constructively, identifying assumptions, dependencies, risks, unintended consequences, and alternative approaches before solutions are agreed.
* Co\-create solutions with business, technology, QA, and vendor teams, helping bridge functional and technical considerations and supporting the Product Owner with prioritization and delivery readiness.
* Build deep product knowledge and take accountability for changes from requirements through test\-scenario definition, validation, deployment readiness, and rollout.
* Prioritize and investigate assigned production issues, identify likely root causes, and bring the right squad, vendor, or technology expertise together to drive effective resolution.
* Support successful adoption of new functionality by preparing release notes and partnering with Learning and Development and Process Enablement colleagues on user guidance and learning materials where needed.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives and broader Talent Acquisition Product Team priorities as opportunities and business needs evolve.
* Build adjacent product and technical skills, including taking on straightforward SaaS configuration and functional enhancement activities where appropriate.

  

What You'll Bring

* 4\+ years of relevant experience in product analysis, business analysis, technology, operations, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills, with confidence to challenge assumptions, identify downstream impacts, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience eliciting, translating, and documenting business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and use cases.
* Experience partnering with developers and engineers to bridge functional and technical requirements and translate business intent into implementation\-ready specifications.
* Experience partnering with QA teams to define test scenarios, validate system behaviour, investigate issues, and manage feedback through delivery.
* Experience working with SaaS products and external vendors, with an interest in developing hands\-on configuration and product administration capabilities.
* Strong working knowledge of Jira and Confluence; Talent Acquisition or HR technology experience is strongly preferred, while exposure to ServiceNow, APIs, integrations, MuleSoft, production support, system troubleshooting, or change management is beneficial.

  

Who You'll Work With


You’ll be part of the Candidate Selection squad within BCG’s global Talent Acquisition Product Team.

  

You’ll collaborate closely with Product Owners, engineers, developers, QA, Scrum Leads, SaaS Engineers, Talent Acquisition teams, and external vendors. Depending on the product or change, you may also partner with Legal, Data Protection, and Responsible AI teams.

  

The team works through close business and technology co\-creation, combining BCG\-built solutions with integrated SaaS platforms and strong vendor partnerships across a global network.
